data.narrative:
GHGSat is a Series D-stage space technology company that has raised $67M+ to date. Valuation analysis draws from a comparables universe of 5 public Space & Aerospace names (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers at similar or adjacent stages, including Apex Space, Varda Space Industries, and Skyryse.

Two triangulation methods apply here. Stage-progression analysis, anchored to the $500M total-raised proxy and applying a 1.5x Series D step-up multiplier, implies a valuation of $750M. Peer-median benchmarking across four same-sector comps—Sierra Space ($8.0B, Series C), Apex Space ($2.3B, Series D), Varda ($1.6B, Series D), and Skyryse ($1.1B, Series C)—yields a median valuation of $1.9B, with a range of $1.1B to $8.0B. Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiples (median 27.4x across the sector) cannot be applied without disclosed revenue data.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $638M (low) to $2.2B (high), with a median of $1.3B. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around stage-specific positioning within the peer set and the outsized valuations of better-capitalized competitors like Sierra Space. Key sensitivities include revenue trajectory relative to comps and the sustainability of the broader Space & Aerospace public market multiples.
